subject: Aligning billing cadence and early-pay options for PayFast onboarding
messages:
From: Jordan Myers <jordan.myers@payfastvendors.com>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.com, monica.patel@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 20 Jan 2026 09:12:00 -08:00
Subject: Vendor onboarding — payment terms question

Hi Laura / Monica,

Thanks again for moving PayFast through the vendor onboarding queue. We have a quick question on payment cadence: our standard customers run Net60, but we know some partners require Net30/45. For strategic accounts we can offer an early-pay discount (0.5%–1.5%) if Redwood can shorten the payment window.

Can you confirm: 1) Redwood's preferred standard term for new vendors (Net30/45/60)? 2) If Redwood would accept an early-pay schedule (e.g., 1% if paid within 15 days) in exchange for a longer baseline term?

We can also attach our onboarding packet (W9, insurance, sample invoice) if helpful — I can send now.

Appreciate the guidance so we can complete the supplier profile.

Best,
Jordan Myers
Head of Partnerships | PayFast Inc.
jordan.myers@payfastvendors.com
+1 415-555-0142
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Myers <jordan.myers@payfastvendors.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Jan 2026 16:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding — payment terms question

Hi Jordan — thanks, this is helpful context. Redwood's standard procurement policy for tier-2 SaaS vendors is Net45, but Finance can accommodate Net30 for strategic partners. Two things we need to check before confirming:

- Finance / AP confirmation on early-pay discounts and how they are administered (Marcus)
- Legal confirmation on the vendor agreement language for early-pay incentives and tax docs (Evelyn)

Jordan, please attach your onboarding packet (W9, certs) and a sample invoice. If you're open to Net45 + an early-pay program, Finance has historically approved a 1% discount for payment within 15 days (2/15 would require different invoice handling). Marcus — can you confirm program mechanics and whether 1% / 15-day is acceptable? Evelyn — please flag any legal requirements for the early-pay clause and confirm we can proceed with a Net45 baseline.

Next steps: once we agree on the term, Laura will generate a PO and send onboarding links.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Procurement Manager | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Jan 2026 09:27:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding — payment terms question

On Wed, Jan 21, 2026 at 4:03 PM Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com> wrote:
> Jordan, please attach your onboarding packet (W9, certs) and a sample invoice. If you're open to Net45 + an early-pay program, Finance has historically approved a 1% discount for payment within 15 days (2/15 would require different invoice handling). Marcus — can you confirm program mechanics and whether 1% / 15-day is acceptable?

Quick internal note: Finance can support Net45 as the baseline and a 1% discount if payment is processed within 15 calendar days of invoice (we call it 1%/15 Net45). Implementation: vendor must opt into our early-pay portal; AP will route eligible invoices into the portal during the normal payment run. No change to gross PO value — the discount is applied at remit. No change to tax treatment, but Legal should confirm documentation.

Also: if vendor insists on Net60 as baseline, we can still offer a 0.5% early-pay at 10–15 days, but we'd prefer Net45 for predictability.

I can run a one-off payment schedule for this partner while they finish onboarding.

—Marcus
Marcus Lin
Director, Finance Operations | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com
From: Jordan Myers <jordan.myers@payfastvendors.com>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.com
Cc: accounts-payable@payfastvendors.com
Date: Mon, 02 Feb 2026 15:04:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding — payment terms question

Laura / Marcus / Evelyn — thanks for the clarity and options. We ran this by our finance team and PayFast is comfortable with Net45 as the baseline and will opt into the 1%/15 early-pay program you described. That should keep cashflow predictable for Redwood while giving PayFast a modest early-pay incentive.

Attached: PayFast_Onboarding_Form.pdf, W9_PayFast.pdf, earlypay_agreement_draft.pdf. I also created a DocuSign envelope for the early-pay addendum: https://www.docusign.com/sign/ABCD-efgH-1234

Next steps on our side: sign the DocuSign and upload the W9 to your vendor portal. Laura — can you confirm the PO number format and whether we need to include the early-pay clause on the PO line?

Happy to hop on a 15-minute call if useful.

Best,
Jordan
Head of Partnerships | PayFast Inc.
attachments: PayFast_Onboarding_Form.pdf (application/form), W9_PayFast.pdf (tax form), earlypay_agreement_draft.pdf (draft addendum)
